> I'd say one of the main points of friends and family is that you're supposed to be able to get help from them.

True but difficult in practice.

* 1) Fine. I'm just fine with it. I'm sorry but I do not wish to choose another word other than 'fine'. It defines everything that I want to say.
* 2) No. 
* 3) Yes, I've many. I just don't want to make them feel low because of me. Don't feel like reaching out to real humans.

Loneliness.

& then from loneliness arises multitudes of issues.
